Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. An attack declaration can't be made during an attack.
Card Q&A.q: My Digimon attacks and digivolves into this card by an effect during the attack. Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to attack again?

Card Q&A.a: The deletion by a rule check is processed first. As soon as your opponent's Digimon attacks and suspends, that Digimon's [When Attacking] effect triggers, but the rule check occurs before it activates. The Digimon with 0 DP will be deleted upon the rule check before the [When Attacking] effect can activate.
Card Q&A.q: This card is in the battle area, and it has X Antibody in its digivolution cards. My opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less and a [When Attacking] effect attacks, and now it's suspended. At such times, this card's [All Turns] effect causes that Digimon's DP to become 0. Which is processed first, the deletion by a rule check or that Digimon's [When Attacking] effect?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Suspend all of your opponent’s Digimon. Then, this Digimon may attack.
[All Turns] While [Rapidmon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, all of your opponent's suspended Digimon get -4000 DP.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your opponent's Digimon are deleted in battle or by having 0 DP, gain 2 memory.
